draw_probability_movement.plus_one: de-vig closing draw probability minus opening draw probability >= 0.01

total_suppression_movement.plus_one: total line falls by >=0.25 or de-vig under probability rises by >=0.02
total_suppression_movement.minus_one: total line rises by >=0.25 or de-vig under probability falls by >=0.02

handicap_compression.plus_one: absolute Asian handicap line falls by >=0.25
handicap_compression.minus_one: absolute Asian handicap line rises by >=0.25

task_accepts_draw.plus_one: timestamped pre-match evidence shows both sides could rationally accept a draw
task_accepts_draw.minus_one: timestamped pre-match evidence shows at least one side had a clear must-win state

attack_suppression.plus_one: timestamped pre-match lineup or availability evidence suppresses attacking output
attack_suppression.minus_one: timestamped pre-match evidence shows unusually attacking availability or selection

market_context_consistency.plus_one: market movement and sourced context independently point toward a close low-margin match
market_context_consistency.minus_one: market movement and sourced context point toward open or decisive play
